To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) energy monitoring circuit design can be used to enable energy aware systems, (ii) voltage scaling of SRAMs can be used to achieve energy efficient systems, (iii) write assists can be used to extend SRAMs to lower voltages.
energy monitoring circuits can be used for system level energy optimizations.

(1) energy monitoring circuits that generate digital representation of energy per operation are demonstrated for an SRAMS application and (2) a 0.1pm energy monitor is demonstrated to be used within a system level power management application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a system level energy monitoring and management circuitry.
the design of energy aware systems and circuits that can be reconfigured for better energy efficiency.
the design and measurement of energy efficient circuits and systems for low power applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this thesis focuses on the development of low power SRAM circuits for a system on chip design.
this thesis presents energy aware system design using on chip reconfigurability, which can adapt to system dynamics and application load.
this thesis demonstrates that energy monitoring can be an important design tool for system designers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this thesis demonstrates the importance of energy aware system design for energy efficient systems.
we have demonstrated energy monitoring circuits that can be embedded into a system to enable self adaptation.
we have demonstrated the feasibility of energy aware design for complex systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
energy monitors can be designed for different domains and they can be used in a system level application for self optimization.
the system can be designed with the flexibility to adapt to changing conditions on the fly and that the energy monitoring circuits are essential for this adaptation.
reconfigurable circuit designs can be utilized in a system level design for better power and energy optimization.
